texto: My city started a new program last year to make our neighborhoods greener. It is called 'City Bikes for Everyone'. The main goal is to encourage people to use bicycles for short trips instead of cars. This helps reduce traffic and air pollution. The city placed special bike stations in many parts of town, like near parks, metro stations, and big office buildings. To use a bike, you need to download an app on your smartphone and register. The first 30 minutes of every ride are free, which is great for quick journeys. I use it sometimes to go to the local market. Last Saturday, I rode one to my friend's house. It was a fun and healthy way to travel, and I saved money on a bus ticket. The program is becoming very popular, especially among young people and students who find it convenient and affordable.

preguntas.pregunta: What is the main purpose of the 'City Bikes for Everyone' program?

opciones.A: To sell new bicycles to students.
opciones.B: To encourage people to exercise more in parks.
opciones.C: To reduce traffic and pollution by promoting bike use.
opciones.D: To offer free transportation for everyone all day.
opciones.E: To replace the city's bus system.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C porque el texto dice claramente que el objetivo principal del programa es 'encourage people to use bicycles for short trips instead of cars' y que esto 'helps reduce traffic and air pollution'. The other options are incorrect. A is wrong because the program is for renting, not selling bikes. B is too specific; while it promotes exercise, its main goal is transportation, not just in parks. D is incorrect because only the first 30 minutes are free, not the whole day. E is not mentioned; the program complements, not replaces, the bus system.

preguntas.pregunta: Based on the text, we can infer that the author...

opciones.A: works for the 'City Bikes for Everyone' program.
opciones.C: thinks the program is a good idea and uses it.
opciones.D: prefers to take the bus for all trips.
opciones.E: believes the program is too expensive.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. Podemos inferir que al autor le parece una buena idea porque describe su experiencia de forma positiva: 'It was a fun and healthy way to travel, and I saved money'. También menciona que usa el servicio: 'I use it sometimes'. This positive language and personal use show approval. The other options are not supported. A is not mentioned. B is false because the author must have a smartphone to 'download an app'. D is incorrect because the author chose the bike over the bus to save money. E is false, as the author calls it 'affordable' and notes that the first 30 minutes are free.
